scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend,mobile -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend" "npm run web -w mobile"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run start -w backend" "npm run preview -w frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test -w frontend && npm run test -w backend
scripts.test:shift-planner: npm run test -w frontend -- src/lib/shiftPlanner && npm run test -w backend -- src/shiftPlanner.test.ts
